summary: Optimi Health Corp., a Canadian pharmaceutical issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 26, 2026, disclosing an equity line of credit (ELOC) agreement with Seven Knots, LLC, entered into on August 13, 2026. Under the agreement, Optimi may sell up to US$100 million of common shares at its discretion, at 97% of the lower of the lowest sale price or volume-weighted average price, subject to a US$2 million per-draw cap and a floor price of 85% of the prior day's closing price. As commitment consideration, Optimi issued convertible promissory notes totaling US$1.5 million (plus US$500,000 contingent on proceeds), convertible at 95% of the 20-day VWAP with a US$3.00 floor, and a 2.99% beneficial ownership cap. A Form F-1 registration statement has been filed but not yet declared effective. This is a financing arrangement, not a takeover or restructuring. Watch for SEC effectiveness and potential dilution.
